name: android-logcat
description: Monitor Android application logs via ADB logcat, using an LLM to detect crashes, exceptions, and ANR errors in real-time. Returns immediately with an operation ID; push alerts are delivered as MCP progress notifications whenever the LLM detects an issue. Use `cancel` with the operation ID to stop monitoring.

parameters.name: serial
parameters.description: Target device/emulator serial (from `adb devices`). Required when more than one device is connected; sets ANDROID_SERIAL for adb. Omit when exactly one device is attached.

parameters.name: pid
parameters.description: Restrict monitoring to a single process id (logcat --pid). Resolve it with `adb shell pidof -s <your.package.name>`. Omit to watch all processes.

livelog.detection_prompt: Look for crashes (FATAL EXCEPTION, NullPointerException, IllegalStateException), Application Not Responding (ANR) errors, native crashes (SIGSEGV, SIGABRT), or any log line at level E (ERROR) or F (FATAL) that indicates a real problem rather than a known-harmless library warning.

custom.usage: Call this tool to start live monitoring of Android logs. The tool returns an operation ID immediately; check `status` to confirm it is running. MCP progress notifications appear automatically whenever the LLM detects an issue. Optional parameters: `serial` (target a specific device when several are connected — get it from `adb devices`), `pid` (restrict to one process — get it from `adb shell pidof -s <package>`), `clear` (set false to keep existing buffered logs instead of clearing them first), and `working_directory`. Call `cancel` with the operation ID when finished.
custom.prerequisites: ADB must be installed and on PATH, with a device or emulator connected (`adb devices` should list it). An OpenAI-compatible LLM server must be reachable — by default Ollama on http://localhost:11434/v1 serving `lfm2.5:8b` (`ollama pull lfm2.5:8b`). Override the endpoint and model without editing this file via the AHMA_LIVELOG_BASE_URL and AHMA_LIVELOG_MODEL environment variables (e.g. AHMA_LIVELOG_MODEL=llama3.2 to use a smaller model).
